name: ae_diagnose
description: Health of this server and of the link into After Effects: the server version, whether After Effects has connected, the port the bridge dials, where the token comes from, the project folder and the data directory. Call it first when a tool cannot reach After Effects.

name: ae_install_bridge
description: Install the bridge this server ships into After Effects' user scripts folder (Startup runs it on every launch) and, when After Effects is running, start it there at once; After Effects then dials this server within a few seconds and ae_diagnose reports it. Safe to repeat: it replaces an older build. Needs 'Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network' switched on in Preferences → Scripting & Expressions.

name: ae_skills
description: The skills this server can load — groups of tools for animation, text, shapes, effects, 3D, compositing, rendering — with which are loaded and the tools each brings.

name: ae_enable_skill
description: Load a skill: its tools join the tool list at once, and the client is told the list changed. Skills stay loaded until ae_disable_skill, unless the server unloads idle ones.

name.description: Skill name as ae_skills lists it.

name: ae_disable_skill
description: Unload a skill, taking its tools out of the list.

name.description: Skill name as ae_skills lists it.

name: find_tool
description: Find the tool for a task across every skill, loaded or not, by saying what you want in English words. Each match carries the tool's command and parameters as a program sends them (snake_case; the tool takes the same names in camelCase), which is enough to call it through run_program without loading anything; pass enable to load the skills the matches live in so the tools can be called by name. Ask here before concluding that something has no tool.

intent.description: What you are trying to do, in English words: "ease the keyframes of a position", "add a drop shadow", "render the composition to a file".

limit.description: Most tools to return, 1 to 25; 8 by default.

enable.description: Load the skills the matches live in, so their tools join the tool list; false by default, because the answer already carries what it takes to call them through run_program.

name: run_program
description: Run a small JavaScript program here on the server that calls the bridge commands itself — ae.layer_add({...}), ae.property_set({...}) — with loops and the results in hand, so a build that decides as it goes costs one call and one reply. Only what the program returns and logs comes back. The program reaches the commands only: no files, no network, no After Effects API beyond them.

code.description: JavaScript. Call commands as ae.<command>({...}) — the tool name without ae_, parameters in snake_case — read input, return a value, log(...) to add a line. A failed command throws {type, message, details}. Up to 200 commands, no files, no network.

input.description: Values the program reads as input, e.g. {"count": 8}.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_undo
description: Undo the last steps in After Effects; every tool call is one step, run_tools is one step for its whole list. The answer says the undo was asked for; ae_list_layers or ae_project_info show the result.

name: ae_redo
description: Redo steps undone with ae_undo; the answer says it was asked for.

name: ae_run_menu_command
description: Run any command of After Effects' menus, by its name in After Effects' language or by its numeric id, on the current selection: ae_select_layers chooses the layers first. For what no tool covers, such as pre-composing or fitting a layer to the composition. Never Undo or Redo this way: use ae_undo and ae_redo, which run them safely.

name.description: The command as the menu shows it, in After Effects' own language.

id.description: The command's numeric id, which is the same in every language.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: run_tools
description: Run a list of bridge commands in one call and one undo step: each step names a command — the tool name without ae_, parameters in snake_case as the bridge reads them, e.g. {"command": "layer_add", "params": {"kind": "text", "text": "Hi"}} — and gets its own result or error. A build of twenty layers costs one round trip instead of twenty.

steps.description: The steps as a JSON array of {"command": <bridge command>, "params": {...}}; commands and parameters are the tools' in snake_case without the ae_ prefix (layer_add, property_set, comp_create).

stopOnError.description: Stop at the first step that fails; false runs every step and reports each.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_script
description: Run ExtendScript inside After Effects for what no tool reaches. A script skips the tools' validation and comes back as text only; prefer the tools and run_tools, and use this for the API they do not cover. Do not call app.executeCommand for Undo or Redo in a script: it stalls the bridge; ae_undo and ae_redo exist for that.

code.description: ExtendScript to run inside After Effects; the value of its last expression comes back as text.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_project_info
description: The open project: its file, whether it has unsaved changes, how many compositions, footage items and folders it holds, the active item and the selection. Read it first to learn what is there.

name: ae_project_new
description: Start a new empty project. Refused while the open project has unsaved changes unless discard is true, so a user's work is never thrown away in silence.

discard.description: Throw away the open project's unsaved changes instead of refusing.

name: ae_project_open
description: Open a project file, replacing the open one. Refused while the open project has unsaved changes unless discard is true. Dialogs about missing footage are suppressed; ae_list_items with kind footage then shows what is missing.

path.description: Path of the .aep, .aepx or .aet file on After Effects' machine.

discard.description: Throw away the open project's unsaved changes instead of refusing.

name: ae_project_save
description: Save the project in place, or under the path given; the folder is created when it does not exist.

path.description: Where to save, for a project saved for the first time or under a new name; empty saves in place.

name: ae_project_close
description: Close the project and leave After Effects with a new empty one. Refused while it has unsaved changes unless discard is true.

discard.description: Throw away the open project's unsaved changes instead of refusing.

name: ae_list_items
description: The items of the project panel — compositions, footage and folders — with ids, sizes, durations and, for footage, the file and whether it is missing. Filter by kind, folder or name; the id is what later calls take when names repeat.

kind.description: Keep only items of this kind: comp, footage or folder.

folder.description: Keep only items directly inside this folder, by name or id.

nameContains.description: Keep only items whose name contains this text, case-insensitive.

limit.description: How many items to return at most; the total is reported regardless.

name: ae_item_info
description: Everything about one item: a composition's settings and its layer list, a footage item's source, a folder's children, and the compositions the item is used in.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

name: ae_item_update
description: Rename an item, change its comment or label colour, or move it into a folder.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

comment.description: The comment shown in the project panel.

label.description: Label colour as a number 0 to 16 as After Effects numbers them; 0 is none.

folder.description: Folder to move the item into, by name or id.

name: ae_item_remove
description: Delete an item from the project. Layers that use it are deleted with it, and so is everything inside a folder; ae_item_info shows where it is used first.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

name: ae_folder_create
description: Create a folder in the project panel, at the root or inside another folder.

folder.description: Parent folder, by name or id; the project root otherwise.

name: ae_import_file
description: Import a file into the project: video, audio, a still, an image sequence, a layered .psd or .ai as a composition, or another .aep merged in. The imported item comes back with its id; use ae_add_layer to put it into a composition.

path.description: Path on After Effects' machine: footage, image, sound, a sequence's first frame, .psd/.ai, or another .aep.

as.description: footage (default), comp (layered file as a composition), comp_cropped (layers cropped to content) or project (merge).

sequence.description: Import the file as the first frame of a numbered sequence.

folder.description: Folder to put the item into, by name or id.

name.description: Name for the item; the file's name otherwise.

forceAlphabetical.description: Sequence: order frames alphabetically; on unless a range is given.

rangeStart.description: Sequence: first frame number to import.

rangeEnd.description: Sequence: last frame number to import.

name: ae_create_comp
description: Create a composition with a size, duration and frame rate; 1920×1080 at 30 fps for 10 seconds unless told otherwise. It opens in the viewer, and later calls that name no composition work on it.

background.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

folder.description: Folder to create it in, by name or id.

name: ae_update_comp
description: Change a composition's settings: name, size, duration, frame rate, pixel aspect, background colour, current time, work area, motion blur and shutter angle, shy layers, or its folder. Only what is passed changes.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

background.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

time.description: The current time of the composition, in seconds.

workAreaStart.description: Start of the work area, in seconds.

workAreaDuration.description: Length of the work area, in seconds.

motionBlur.description: Switch motion blur on or off for the composition.

folder.description: Folder to move it into, by name or id.

frameBlending.description: Frame blending for layers that ask for it.

displayStartFrame.description: First frame number of the timeline.

displayStartTime.description: Start time of the timeline in seconds.

name: ae_duplicate_comp
description: Duplicate a composition, optionally under a new name; the layers keep pointing at the same footage and nested compositions.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_open_comp
description: Open a composition in the viewer so the user sees it, and set its current time; later calls that name no composition work on it.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_list_layers
description: The layers of a composition from top to bottom with index, kind, switches, in and out points, parent and source; filter by kind or name. The index is what later calls take, and it changes when layers are added, removed or moved.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

kind.description: solid, null, adjustment, text, shape, camera, light, or item (footage or a composition from the project).

nameContains.description: Only layers whose name contains this, case-insensitive.

limit.description: How many layers to return at most; the total is reported regardless.

name: ae_layer_info
description: Everything about one layer: kind, switches, timing, parent, blending mode, transform values with which of them are animated, effects, mask count, and the text of a text layer.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_add_layer
description: Add a layer to a composition: a solid, null or adjustment layer, a text layer (a box when width and height are given), an empty shape layer, a camera or light, or a footage item or nested composition from the project. New layers go to the top unless at says otherwise; the answer carries the index later calls use.

kind.description: solid, null, adjustment, text, shape, camera, light, or item (footage or a composition from the project).

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

item.description: For kind item: the footage or composition, by name or id.

color.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

width.description: For a solid: its width; for text: the width of a text box.

height.description: For a solid: its height; for text: the height of a text box.

duration.description: Length of the layer in seconds; the composition's otherwise.

position.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in composition pixels; the centre otherwise.

lightType.description: For kind light: PARALLEL, SPOT, POINT or AMBIENT.

startTime.description: When the layer starts, in composition seconds.

at.description: Index for the layer, 1 the top; the top otherwise.

name: ae_update_layer
description: Change a layer's switches and timing: name, video, solo, shy, lock, in and out points, start time, stretch, parent, blending mode, 3D, motion blur, adjustment, guide, label, comment, quality, audio, collapse, time remapping, track matte, auto-orient, preserve transparency, effects and frame blending. Only what is passed changes.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

enabled.description: Video switch: whether the layer renders.

startTime.description: When the layer starts, in composition seconds.

stretch.description: Time stretch in percent; 100 is normal speed, -100 reversed.

parent.description: Parent by name or index; empty removes it.

parentJump.description: When parenting, keep the transform values rather than the place on screen.

blendingMode.description: NORMAL, DISSOLVE, DANCING_DISSOLVE, DARKEN, MULTIPLY, COLOR_BURN, CLASSIC_COLOR_BURN, LINEAR_BURN, DARKER_COLOR, ADD, LIGHTEN, SCREEN, COLOR_DODGE, CLASSIC_COLOR_DODGE, LINEAR_DODGE, LIGHTER_COLOR, OVERLAY, SOFT_LIGHT, HARD_LIGHT, LINEAR_LIGHT, VIVID_LIGHT, PIN_LIGHT, HARD_MIX, DIFFERENCE, CLASSIC_DIFFERENCE, EXCLUSION, SUBTRACT, DIVIDE, HUE, SATURATION, COLOR, LUMINOSITY, STENCIL_ALPHA, STENCIL_LUMA, SILHOUETTE_ALPHA, SILHOUETTE_LUMA, ALPHA_ADD or LUMINESCENT_PREMUL.

motionBlur.description: Motion blur switch of the layer.

adjustment.description: Make a solid an adjustment layer or back.

guide.description: Guide layer: visible while working, left out of renders.

label.description: Label colour as a number 0 to 16 as After Effects numbers them; 0 is none.

quality.description: Rendering quality: BEST, DRAFT or WIREFRAME.

audioEnabled.description: Audio switch of a layer that has sound.

timeRemap.description: Switch time remapping on, which adds the Time Remap property.

trackMatte.description: Track matte layer by name or index; pair with trackMatteType.

trackMatteType.description: ALPHA (the default when a matte layer is named), ALPHA_INVERTED, LUMA, LUMA_INVERTED, or NONE to remove the matte.

name: ae_transform_layer
description: Set a layer's anchor point, position, scale, rotation, opacity and, for 3D layers, orientation and X/Y rotation. A property that already has keyframes gets a keyframe at time instead of a value everywhere; the answer shows the transform and which of it is animated.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

anchor.description: Anchor point [x, y] or [x, y, z] in layer pixels.

position.description: Position [x, y] or [x, y, z] in composition pixels.

scale.description: Scale [x, y] or [x, y, z] in percent; 100 keeps the size.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees; the Z rotation of a 3D layer.

orientation.description: 3D layers: orientation [x, y, z] in degrees.

time.description: Keyed at this time when the property has keyframes; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_remove_layers
description: Delete one or more layers from a composition; the footage they used stays in the project.

layers.description: Layers to delete, each by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_duplicate_layer
description: Duplicate a layer right above the original, with its effects, masks and keyframes, optionally under a new name.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_move_layer
description: Move a layer to an index, to the top or bottom, or right above or below another layer.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

to.description: Where to: an index (1 is the top), top or bottom.

before.description: Put it right above this layer, by name or index.

after.description: Put it right below this layer, by name or index.

name: ae_select_layers
description: Select layers in the timeline, which is what menu commands and the user's next action act on.

layers.description: Layers to select, each by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

mode.description: replace (default), add (keep the selection), none (deselect all) or all.

name: ae_property_tree
description: The property tree of a layer, which is where everything After Effects animates lives: Transform, Effects and their parameters, Masks, Text, Material Options, Audio. Each node carries its display name, its match name — stable across languages, use it in paths — its type, value, and whether it is animated or driven by an expression. Start here before reading or setting a property.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

path.description: Group to start from, as a path; the whole layer when empty.

depth.description: How many levels below the start to list; 2 shows the groups and what is directly in them.

values.description: Include the current value of every property listed; false lists names and types only.

name: ae_get_property
description: One property by path: its value at a time, type, limits, keyframe count, expression and expression error. Any property of any effect is reachable this way; ae_property_tree lists the paths.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_set_property
description: Set any property of a layer by path: transform values, effect parameters, mask settings, text (a string or an object with font, size and colours), shapes, markers, or switch a group such as an effect on and off. With time the value becomes a keyframe; an expression can be put on or taken off at the same time. The answer is the property as it stands afterwards.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

value.description: The new value in the property's shape: a number; [x, y] or [x, y, z]; a colour as [r, g, b, a] 0 to 1 or #rrggbb; true/false for a checkbox; a string or an object {text, font, font_size, fill_color, stroke_color, stroke_width, justification, tracking, leading} for text; {vertices, in_tangents, out_tangents, closed} for a mask or shape path; {comment, duration} for a marker.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the value as a keyframe at this time; without it an unanimated property changes everywhere and an animated one is keyed at the current time.

expression.description: An expression to put on the property; an empty string removes it.

enabled.description: For a group such as an effect or a mask: switch it on or off; for a property with an expression: enable or disable the expression.

name: ae_capture_frame
description: A frame of a composition as a picture, scaled to width and laid over the composition's background colour (After Effects renders the background as transparency), returned as image content next to the path of the PNG. Look at it before judging layout, colour or timing.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

width.description: Width in pixels, scaled down from the composition; 1280 by default.

path.description: Where to write the PNG on After Effects' machine; the captures folder otherwise.

transparent.description: Keep the background transparent rather than the composition's colour.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_list_keyframes
description: Every keyframe of a property: time, value, interpolation on each side, ease (speed and influence), and for spatial properties the tangents and roving. Read this before easing or editing keys; the indices it gives are what the other keyframe tools take.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_set_keyframes
description: Set keyframes on a property in one call: a list of {time, value} pairs, each optionally with its own easing, plus a preset or interpolation, influence and speed that apply to all of them. Existing keys at other times stay unless replace is true. A key at a time that already has one replaces it. Values take the same forms as ae_set_property.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

keys.description: Keyframes as a list of objects with time (seconds) and value (as ae_set_property takes it); any may also carry its own preset, in_interpolation, out_interpolation, influence_in, influence_out, speed_in, speed_out, in_tangent, out_tangent or label.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

inInterpolation.description: Interpolation into the key: LINEAR, BEZIER or HOLD.

outInterpolation.description: Interpolation out of the key: LINEAR, BEZIER or HOLD.

influenceIn.description: Ease influence into the key, 0.1 to 100 percent; 33.33 is Easy Ease. Setting it makes the side bezier.

influenceOut.description: Ease influence out of the key, 0.1 to 100 percent; 33.33 is Easy Ease. Setting it makes the side bezier.

speedIn.description: Speed into the key in units per second; 0 comes to a rest, as Easy Ease does.

speedOut.description: Speed out of the key in units per second; 0 starts from rest, as Easy Ease does.

label.description: Keyframe label colour as a number 0 to 16 as After Effects numbers them; 0 is none.

name: ae_remove_keyframes
description: Remove keyframes of a property: the ones at the indices or times given, or all of them when neither is. A property with no keys left keeps its last value.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

indices.description: Keyframe indices as ae_list_keyframes numbers them, 1 first; the keys at times, or all keys, when empty.

times.description: Times in seconds of the keyframes meant, each within half a frame of a key; the keys at indices, or all keys, when empty.

name: ae_ease_keyframes

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

indices.description: Keyframe indices as ae_list_keyframes numbers them, 1 first; the keys at times, or all keys, when empty.

times.description: Times in seconds of the keyframes meant, each within half a frame of a key; the keys at indices, or all keys, when empty.

preset.description: easy_ease (both sides), ease_in, ease_out, linear, or hold; the explicit settings below override a preset side by side.

inInterpolation.description: Interpolation into the key: LINEAR, BEZIER or HOLD.

outInterpolation.description: Interpolation out of the key: LINEAR, BEZIER or HOLD.

spatialAutoBezier.description: For spatial properties: let After Effects pick the path tangents.

separate.description: Separate the dimensions (true) or join them again (false); empty only reports.

name: ae_set_expression
description: Put an expression on a property and check it compiles: a broken expression is reported with After Effects' own error message and not left on the property, so the answer can be trusted. layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

expression.description: The expression, in After Effects' JavaScript; empty removes the expression on the property.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

enabled.description: Leave the expression switched on; false puts it on the property disabled.

checkOnly.description: Only check that the expression compiles and what it yields, restoring the property afterwards.

name: ae_list_markers
description: The markers of a composition, or of a layer when one is named: time, comment, duration, label, chapter, URL, cue point name and, for composition markers, whether the region is protected.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

layer.description: A layer by name or index for layer markers; the composition's own markers when empty.

name: ae_set_marker
description: Add a marker on the composition, or on a layer when one is named, at a time with a comment and optional duration, label, chapter, URL, frame target and cue point name. A marker already at that time is replaced.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

comment.description: The marker's comment, shown on it in the timeline.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

layer.description: A layer by name or index for layer markers; the composition's own markers when empty.

duration.description: Duration of the marker in seconds; 0 for a point marker.

label.description: Label colour as a number 0 to 16 as After Effects numbers them; 0 is none.

chapter.description: Chapter name, for formats that carry chapters.

frameTarget.description: Frame target of the web link.

cuePointName.description: Cue point name, for Flash and streaming cue points.

protectedRegion.description: For composition markers: protect the region the marker spans from being retimed.

eventCuePoint.description: Make the cue point an event rather than navigation.

parameters.description: Key and value pairs the marker carries, as an object of strings; for cue points and scripts that read them.

name: ae_remove_markers
description: Remove markers of the composition, or of a layer when one is named: those at the indices or times given, or all of them.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

layer.description: A layer by name or index for layer markers; the composition's own markers when empty.

indices.description: Marker indices as ae_list_markers numbers them, 1 first; the markers at times, or all markers, when empty.

times.description: Times in seconds of the markers meant; the markers at indices, or all markers, when empty.

name: ae_time_remap
description: Time remapping of a footage or nested composition layer: switch it on, which puts keys at the layer's start and end, and set the keys that map composition time to source time (both in seconds) for freeze frames, slow motion and reversal. Ease the keys with ae_ease_keyframes on the path ADBE Time Remapping; enabled false switches it off.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

enabled.description: Switch time remapping on (the default) or off.

keys.description: Keyframes as {time, value}: the composition time and the source time it shows, both in seconds.

replace.description: Remove the existing time remap keys before setting the new ones.

name: ae_text_info
description: Everything about a text layer: the document with its text, font, size, colours, character and paragraph settings, whether it is point or box text, its paragraphs and composed lines as character ranges, the source text keyframes, every animator with its properties and selectors (with the paths the keyframe tools take), and the path options when the text runs along a mask.

layer.description: The text layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_text_style
description: Style a text layer: the text itself, the font (by PostScript name, or by family and style as ae_text_fonts lists them), size, fill and stroke, justification, tracking, kerning, leading, baseline shift, faux bold and italic, caps, horizontal and vertical scale, paragraph margins and indents, box size, and the axes of a variable font. With start and end, paragraph or line only those characters change. The answer is the document as it stands afterwards; ae_text_layout has the paragraph direction, composer and box settings.

layer.description: The text layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Style the document at this time, as a keyframe when the source text is animated.

start.description: First character the style applies to, 0 first; the whole text when start and end are empty.

end.description: Character after the last one the style applies to.

paragraph.description: Change one paragraph, 1 first; ae_text_info lists them.

paragraphEnd.description: The last paragraph the change applies to, with paragraph.

line.description: Style one composed line, as the text wraps, 1 first; ae_text_info lists them.

lineEnd.description: The last composed line the style applies to, with line.

font.description: Font by PostScript name, as ae_text_fonts gives it.

fontFamily.description: Font family name; pair with fontStyle.

fontStyle.description: Font style within the family, Regular when empty.

fontAxes.description: For a variable font: the axis values as an object by tag, such as {"wght": 700, "wdth": 90}; axes left out keep the font's defaults. ae_text_fonts with variable lists the axes and their ranges.

fillColor.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

strokeColor.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

strokeOverFill.description: Draw the stroke over the fill rather than under it.

justification.description: LEFT_JUSTIFY, CENTER_JUSTIFY, RIGHT_JUSTIFY, FULL_JUSTIFY_LASTLINE_LEFT, FULL_JUSTIFY_LASTLINE_CENTER, FULL_JUSTIFY_LASTLINE_RIGHT or FULL_JUSTIFY_LASTLINE_FULL.

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em.

leading.description: Leading in pixels; switches auto leading off.

autoLeading.description: Let the leading follow the font size.

tsume.description: Tsume, the proportional spacing of CJK characters, in percent.

spaceBefore.description: Space before each paragraph in pixels.

spaceAfter.description: Space after each paragraph in pixels.

boxSize.description: For box text: [width, height] of the box in pixels.

kerning.description: Manual kerning between the character and the next, in thousandths of an em.

noBreak.description: Keep the characters from breaking across lines.

autoKern.description: Automatic kerning: METRIC_KERN, OPTICAL_KERN or NO_AUTO_KERN.

caps.description: Caps: FONT_NORMAL_CAPS, FONT_SMALL_CAPS, FONT_ALL_CAPS or FONT_ALL_SMALL_CAPS.

lineJoin.description: Stroke line join: LINE_JOIN_MITER, LINE_JOIN_ROUND or LINE_JOIN_BEVEL.

baselineDirection.description: In vertical text: BASELINE_WITH_STREAM, BASELINE_VERTICAL_ROTATED or BASELINE_VERTICAL_CROSS_STREAM.

name: ae_text_layout
description: Paragraph and box settings of a text layer: direction, leading type, composer engine, digit set, hyphenation, hanging punctuation, start and end indents, line orientation, and for box text the auto-fit policy, vertical alignment, first baseline and inset; or reset the character or paragraph styles. With paragraph only that paragraph changes.

layer.description: The text layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Change the document at this time, as a keyframe when the source text is animated.

paragraph.description: Change one paragraph, 1 first; ae_text_info lists them.

paragraphEnd.description: The last paragraph the change applies to, with paragraph.

composer.description: LATIN_CJK_ENGINE or UNIVERSAL_TYPE_ENGINE, the latter for Arabic, Hebrew and Indic scripts.

everyLineComposer.description: Compose every line of a paragraph together for evener breaks.

digitSet.description: DEFAULT_DIGITS, ARABIC_DIGITS, ARABIC_DIGITS_RTL, HINDI_DIGITS or FARSI_DIGITS.

hangingRoman.description: Hang Roman punctuation outside the margins.

startIndent.description: Indent from the start of the line in pixels.

endIndent.description: Indent from the end of the line in pixels.

boxAutoFit.description: For box text, how the box grows with the text: NONE, HEIGHT_CURSOR, HEIGHT_PRECISE_BOUNDS or HEIGHT_BASELINE.

boxVerticalAlignment.description: For box text: TOP, CENTER, BOTTOM or JUSTIFY.

boxFirstBaseline.description: For box text, where the first baseline sits: ASCENT, CAP_HEIGHT, LEADING, X_HEIGHT, EM_BOX, LEGACY_METRIC, TYPO_ASCENT, MINIMUM_VALUE_ROMAN or MINIMUM_VALUE_ASIAN.

boxFirstBaselineMinimum.description: For box text: the least distance of the first baseline from the top, in pixels.

boxInset.description: For box text: inset of the text from the box edges, in pixels.

reset.description: Reset the styles to the defaults first: character, paragraph or both.

name: ae_text_fonts
description: The fonts installed on this machine as After Effects sees them: family, style and PostScript name, with a query to narrow the list, or only one font by PostScript name, family or id, only the missing ones, only variable fonts with their axes, only fonts for a writing script or with glyphs for a text. Use the names it gives in ae_text_style; a font the project asks for but the machine lacks is marked substituted.

query.description: Keep only fonts whose family, style or PostScript name contains this, case-insensitive.

limit.description: Most fonts to list; 50 by default.

postscriptName.description: Only the font with this PostScript name.

id.description: Only the font with this id, as detail gives it.

family.description: Only this family, with face to pick one style.

face.description: The style within family, such as Bold.

missing.description: Only the fonts the project asks for and the machine lacks or substitutes.

variable.description: Only variable fonts, with their axes.

script.description: Only fonts that write this script: a CTScript name such as CT_CYRILLIC_SCRIPT, CT_ARABIC_SCRIPT or CT_JAPANESE_SCRIPT.

glyphsFor.description: Only fonts with glyphs for every character of this text; the answer also says which scripts the text uses and the default font for each.

detail.description: Every detail per font: id, full name, file, version, type and writing scripts.

name: ae_add_text_animator
description: Add a text animator to a text layer: the properties it animates (opacity, position, scale, tracking, fill colour and the rest, with their values) and a selector that says which characters, words or lines it reaches. comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_update_text_animator

addSelector.description: Add the selector as a new one instead of changing the existing selector of its type.

name: ae_remove_text_animator
description: Remove a text animator, or only one of its properties or selectors when one is named.

layer.description: The text layer by name or index.

animator.description: The animator by its name or its index in the layer's Animators, 1 first.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

property.description: Remove only this property of the animator, by alias or match name.

selector.description: Remove only this selector of the animator, by index.

name: ae_text_path
description: Run the text of a layer along one of its masks, or take it off the path: which mask, reversed, perpendicular to the path, forced alignment, and the first and last margins. Draw the mask on the text layer first with ae_set_property on Masks.

layer.description: The text layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

mask.description: The mask on the layer the text follows, by name or index; the word none takes the text off its path.

reverse.description: Run the text the other way along the path.

perpendicular.description: Stand the characters perpendicular to the path.

forceAlignment.description: Spread the text between the first and last margins.

firstMargin.description: Where the text starts along the path, in pixels.

lastMargin.description: Where the text ends along the path, in pixels.

name: ae_shape_contents
description: The contents of a shape layer as a tree: groups with their transform, the shapes (rectangle, ellipse, star, path), the paint (fill, stroke, gradients) and the operators (trim paths, repeater, merge, offset, round corners, pucker and bloat, twist, wiggle, zig zag), each with its settings by plain name and the path the other tools take.

layer.description: The shape layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

path.description: Group to start from, by path; the whole contents when empty.

depth.description: How many levels of groups to open; 3 by default.

name: ae_add_shape
description: Add an item to a shape layer: a group, a rectangle, ellipse, star or path, a fill or stroke, or an operator, into the layer's contents or a group, with its settings. A shape added at the top level with fill or stroke gets its own group with the paint, which is how After Effects draws it; the answer carries the paths to animate it with the keyframe tools.

layer.description: The shape layer by name or index.

kind.description: group, rect, ellipse, star, path, fill, stroke, gradient_fill, gradient_stroke, trim, repeater, merge, offset, round_corners, pucker_bloat, twist, wiggle_paths, wiggle_transform, or zigzag.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

into.description: The group to add into, by path; the layer's contents when empty.

name.description: Name of the new item, or of the group made for it.

settings.description: Settings as an object of plain names: size, position, roundness for rect and ellipse; points, inner_radius, outer_radius, rotation, type (1 star, 2 polygon) for star; path as {vertices, in_tangents, out_tangents, closed} for path; color, opacity, fill_rule for fill; color, width, opacity, line_cap, line_join, miter_limit, dashes [dash, gap, ...], dash_offset for stroke; start, end, offset, type (1 simultaneously, 2 individually) for trim; copies, offset, anchor, position, scale, rotation, start_opacity, end_opacity for repeater; amount, radius, angle, center, size, detail, ridges, points, frequency, seed for the other operators; anchor, position, scale, skew, skew_axis, rotation, opacity for a group. fill.description: Add a fill of this colour beside the shape.

stroke.description: Add a stroke of this colour beside the shape.

strokeWidth.description: Width of that stroke in pixels.

at.description: Position in the group, 1 first; at the end when empty. Paint and operators act on what is above them.

layer.description: The shape layer by name or index.

path.description: The item by path as ae_shape_contents gives it.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

enabled.description: Switch the item on or off.

settings.description: Settings as an object of plain names: size, position, roundness for rect and ellipse; points, inner_radius, outer_radius, rotation, type (1 star, 2 polygon) for star; path as {vertices, in_tangents, out_tangents, closed} for path; color, opacity, fill_rule for fill; color, width, opacity, line_cap, line_join, miter_limit, dashes [dash, gap, ...], dash_offset for stroke; start, end, offset, type (1 simultaneously, 2 individually) for trim; copies, offset, anchor, position, scale, rotation, start_opacity, end_opacity for repeater; amount, radius, angle, center, size, detail, ridges, points, frequency, seed for the other operators; anchor, position, scale, skew, skew_axis, rotation, opacity for a group. at.description: Move the item to this position in its group, 1 first.

path.description: The item by path as ae_shape_contents gives it.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

ellipse.description: An ellipse inside [x, y, width, height] in layer pixels.

mask.description: The mask by name or index, 1 first.
