limit.description: Most presets to list; 60 by default.

name: ae_apply_preset
description: Apply an animation preset to layers, by the name ae_find_presets gives or a path to an .ffx file. Presets add effects, keyframes, expressions or text animators; the answer says how many effects each layer gained, and ae_layer_info shows the rest.

layers.description: Layers to apply the preset to, each by name or index.

preset.description: The preset by name as ae_find_presets gives it, or a path to an .ffx file.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_layer_styles
description: The layer styles on a layer (drop shadow, glows, bevel, satin, overlays, stroke) with every parameter.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_set_layer_style
description: Add a layer style to a layer, or change one it has: switch it on or off and set its parameters by name (as keyframes when time is given). A new style is added through the Layer menu in After Effects' own language, with the layer selected for a moment; when that fails the answer says so and the style can be added from Layer > Layer Styles by hand.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

style.description: drop_shadow, inner_shadow, outer_glow, inner_glow, bevel_emboss, satin, color_overlay, gradient_overlay or stroke.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

enabled.description: Switch the style on or off.

settings.description: Parameters as an object keyed by parameter name (as the interface shows it), match name or index; values as ae_set_property takes them: numbers, [x, y] points, colours as #rrggbb or [r, g, b], true or false for checkboxes, 1-based option numbers for popups, a layer name for layer parameters.

time.description: Set the parameters as keyframes at this time.

name: ae_remove_layer_style
description: Remove a layer style from a layer.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

style.description: drop_shadow, inner_shadow, outer_glow, inner_glow, bevel_emboss, satin, color_overlay, gradient_overlay or stroke.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_3d_info
description: The 3D state of a composition (renderer, cameras, lights, how many 3D layers) or of one layer: its transform, point of interest, camera lens and depth of field, light settings, material options, geometry options, and the renderers the composition can switch to.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

layer.description: One layer to describe in full; the composition's 3D overview when empty.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_set_camera
description: Set a camera: position and point of interest (or look_at a layer), one or two node, zoom or focal length in millimetres, depth of field with focus distance, aperture and blur level, and the iris and highlight settings; as keyframes when time is given.

layer.description: The camera layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the values as keyframes at this time.

position.description: [x, y, z] position of the camera in composition pixels.

pointOfInterest.description: [x, y, z] the camera or light aims at, in composition pixels.

lookAt.description: A layer whose position becomes the point of interest.

twoNode.description: Aim at the point of interest (two node) or not (one node, free rotation).

zoom.description: Zoom in pixels: the distance from the camera to the plane that fills the frame.

focalLengthMm.description: Focal length in millimetres on a 36 mm film back; sets zoom from the composition width.

depthOfField.description: Switch depth of field on or off.

aperture.description: Aperture in pixels; larger blurs more.

irisShape.description: Iris shape as an option number, 1 fast rectangle, then triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon.

name: ae_set_light
description: Set a light: type, position and point of interest (or look_at a layer), intensity, colour, cone angle and feather for spots, falloff with its start and distance, and shadows with darkness and diffusion; as keyframes when time is given.

layer.description: The light layer by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the values as keyframes at this time.

position.description: [x, y, z] position of the light in composition pixels.

pointOfInterest.description: [x, y, z] the camera or light aims at, in composition pixels.

lookAt.description: A layer whose position becomes the point of interest.

twoNode.description: Aim at the point of interest (two node) or not (one node, free rotation).

color.description: [r, g, b] with components 0 to 1, or #rrggbb.

coneAngle.description: Cone angle in degrees, for spot lights.

coneFeather.description: Cone feather in percent, for spot lights.

falloffStart.description: Where the falloff starts, in pixels.

falloffDistance.description: Over how many pixels the light falls off.

name: ae_set_material
description: Set the material options of a 3D layer (switching it to 3D if it is not): casting and accepting shadows, accepting lights, ambient, diffuse, specular intensity and shininess, metal, and the reflection, transparency and refraction settings of renderers that have them.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the values as keyframes at this time.

castsShadows.description: on, off, or only (cast or accept shadows without rendering the layer itself).

lightTransmission.description: Light transmission in percent: how much light passes through to cast coloured shadows.

acceptsShadows.description: on, off, or only (cast or accept shadows without rendering the layer itself).

appearsInReflections.description: Show the layer in reflections, where the renderer has them.

metal.description: Metal in percent: how much the specular takes the layer's colour.

name: ae_set_geometry
description: Set the geometry options of a 3D layer under a renderer that extrudes (Advanced 3D, Cinema 4D): extrusion depth, bevel style, direction and depth, hole bevel depth, curvature and segments. Under the Classic 3D renderer the answer says so and names the renderers to switch to.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the values as keyframes at this time.

bevelStyle.description: Bevel style as an option number: 1 none, 2 angular, 3 concave, 4 convex.

bevelDirection.description: Bevel direction as an option number, where the renderer has it.

curvature.description: Curvature in percent, for curved layers.

name: ae_set_renderer
description: The renderer of a composition: Classic 3D, Advanced 3D or Cinema 4D by name or a word of it; with no renderer the answer only reports the current one and the choices. The renderer decides which material and geometry options exist.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

renderer.description: The renderer by its name or match name (ADBE Advanced 3d, ADBE Ernst for Cinema 4D, ADBE Standard 3d for Classic 3D), or a word of it; empty only reports.

name: ae_precompose
description: Move layers into a new nested composition in their place: the layers named, the new composition's name, and whether their attributes (transform, effects, masks) move with them or stay on the new layer, which works for one layer only.

layers.description: Layers to move into the new composition, each by name or index.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

moveAttributes.description: Move the layers' attributes into the new composition (true, the default) or leave them on the new layer (one layer only).

open.description: Open the new composition in the viewer.

name: ae_comp_tree
description: The compositions nested in a composition, as a tree with the layer each sits on, down to a depth; and the compositions this one is used in. Read it before changing a composition several others depend on.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

depth.description: How many levels of nesting to open; 4 by default.

name: ae_replace_footage
description: Relink or replace a footage item for every layer that uses it: with a file (or an image sequence starting at that file), with a solid of a colour, or with a placeholder. Interpretation stays as it was.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

file.description: Path of the new file; the first frame when sequence is true.

sequence.description: Treat the file as the start of an image sequence.

forceAlphabetical.description: For a sequence: take the frames in alphabetical order rather than by number.

solidColor.description: Replace with a solid of this colour instead of a file.

placeholder.description: Replace with a placeholder instead of a file.

name.description: Name for the solid or placeholder; the item's name when empty.

width.description: Width of the solid or placeholder; the item's when empty.

height.description: Height of the solid or placeholder; the item's when empty.

duration.description: Duration of the placeholder in seconds.

name: ae_interpret_footage
description: Interpret footage as the Interpret Footage dialog does: alpha as ignored, straight or premultiplied (or guessed), inverted, frame rate to conform to, field separation, pulldown removal (or guessed), loop count and pixel aspect ratio. With nothing to change the answer reports the interpretation as it stands.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

premulColor.description: The colour the alpha was premultiplied with, as #rrggbb or [r, g, b].

guessAlpha.description: Let After Effects guess the alpha interpretation.

frameRate.description: Frame rate to conform the footage to.

removePulldown.description: Pulldown phase to remove, as After Effects names them (OFF, WSSWW, SSWWW, SWWWS, WWWSS, WWSSW, or the advanced phases).

guessPulldown.description: Let After Effects guess the 3:2 pulldown.

loop.description: How many times the footage loops.

pixelAspect.description: Pixel aspect ratio, 1 for square pixels.

name: ae_set_proxy
description: Set, switch or remove the proxy of a footage item or composition: a file, an image sequence, a solid or a placeholder stands in while use is true, and the full item renders when it is false.

item.description: The item by its name as the project panel shows it, or by its id when names repeat.

file.description: Path of the proxy file; the first frame when sequence is true.

sequence.description: Treat the file as the start of an image sequence.

use.description: Use the proxy (true) or the full item (false); the proxy stays set either way.

solidColor.description: A solid of this colour as the proxy.

width.description: Width of the solid or placeholder proxy.

height.description: Height of the solid or placeholder proxy.

frameRate.description: Frame rate of the placeholder proxy.

duration.description: Duration of the placeholder proxy in seconds.

name: ae_replace_layer_source
description: Put another footage item or composition on a layer, keeping the layer's transform, effects, masks and keyframes; expressions that name the old source are fixed when asked.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

item.description: The footage item or composition to put on the layer, by name or id.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

fixExpressions.description: Rewrite expressions that name the old source so they keep working; true by default.

name: ae_project_footage
description: The footage of the project with the file each points to, whether it is missing and how many compositions use it; only the missing or only file-backed items when asked. Relink missing files with ae_replace_footage.

onlyMissing.description: Only footage whose file is missing.

onlyFiles.description: Only footage backed by a file, leaving out solids and placeholders.

name: ae_project_cleanup
description: Tidy the project as the File menu does: consolidate duplicate footage, remove footage no composition uses, or reduce the project to the items named and what they use. The answer counts what went.

consolidate.description: Merge footage items that point to the same file.

reduceTo.description: Keep only these items (by name or id) and what they use; everything else goes.

name: ae_collect_files
description: Collect the project into a folder: every file the footage points to is copied into a (Footage) folder, the items are relinked to the copies, and the project is saved there under its name; missing footage is listed and skipped. The open project becomes the collected copy.

folder.description: Folder to collect into; created when missing.

name.description: Name of the collected project file without .aep; the project's own name when empty.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_render_queue
description: The render queue: every item with its composition, status, span, render flag and output modules (file, format and settings, post-render action), whether After Effects is rendering, and whether Media Encoder can take the queue.

settings.description: Include every settable render and output setting of each item.

name: ae_render_templates
description: The render settings templates (Best Settings, Draft Settings and the user's own) and output module templates (Lossless, H.264, PNG Sequence and the rest) this After Effects has; their names are what ae_add_render takes. With an empty queue a composition is needed to read them.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_add_render
description: Put a composition in the render queue: render settings and output module templates by name, the output file (or a folder, which takes the composition's name and the template's extension), the span as start and end or the work area, skip frames, a post-render action, and any render or output settings by their names. The item is queued and waits for ae_render.

outputPath.description: Where to write the output: a file path, or a folder to take the composition's name.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

renderTemplate.description: Render settings template by name, as ae_render_templates lists them.

outputTemplate.description: Output module template by name, as ae_render_templates lists them.

outputModule.description: Which output module of the item the path and template apply to, 1 first.

start.description: Start of the span to render, in seconds.

end.description: End of the span to render, in seconds.

workArea.description: Render the composition's work area instead of a span.

skipFrames.description: Render every nth frame only; 0 renders all.

renderSettings.description: Render settings by name as the Render Settings dialog shows them, such as Quality, Resolution, Motion Blur, Frame Rate; ae_render_queue with settings lists the settable ones.

outputSettings.description: Output module settings by name, such as Format, Channels, Depth, Color, Video Output, Audio Output; ae_render_queue with settings lists the settable ones.

name: ae_update_render
description: Change an item of the render queue that has not rendered yet: templates, output file, span, skip frames, render flag, post-render action, render or output settings.

item.description: Index of the item in the render queue, 1 first, as ae_render_queue lists them.

outputPath.description: Where to write the output: a file path, or a folder to take the composition's name.

outputModule.description: Which output module of the item the path and template apply to, 1 first.

start.description: Start of the span to render, in seconds.

end.description: End of the span to render, in seconds.

workArea.description: Render the composition's work area instead of a span.

skipFrames.description: Render every nth frame only; 0 renders all.

render.description: Queue the item (true) or leave it unqueued (false).

renderSettings.description: Render settings by name as the Render Settings dialog shows them, such as Quality, Resolution, Motion Blur, Frame Rate; ae_render_queue with settings lists the settable ones.

outputSettings.description: Output module settings by name, such as Format, Channels, Depth, Color, Video Output, Audio Output; ae_render_queue with settings lists the settable ones.

name: ae_remove_render
description: Remove items from the render queue: one by index, all of them, or those with a status such as DONE.

item.description: Index of the item in the render queue, 1 first, as ae_render_queue lists them.

status.description: Remove the items with this status: DONE, UNQUEUED, QUEUED, NEEDS_OUTPUT, USER_STOPPED, ERR_STOPPED, WILL_CONTINUE.

name: ae_render
description: Render the queued items (or only the ones named) inside After Effects. By default the tool waits: After Effects is busy until the render ends, so give a timeout the render fits in. With wait false the render starts and the call returns; ae_render_queue shows the progress and ae_render_control stops or pauses it. The answer is the queue with each output file and its size. The farm renders through aerender while After Effects stays free.

items.description: Indices of the items to render; every queued item when empty.

wait.description: Wait for the render (true, the default), or start it and return at once; ae_render_queue then shows the progress and ae_render_control stops or pauses it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_render_control
description: Stop, pause or resume a render that ae_render started without waiting, switch the finished notification, or bring the Render Queue to the front. After Effects answers the bridge only between frames it yields on, so a render in the application usually ends before stop or pause reach it; a render that must be cancellable goes through the farm (ae_farm_submit, ae_farm_cancel).

action.description: stop, pause or resume the render that ae_render started without waiting; empty to only set notify or show.

notify.description: Have After Effects notify when the queue finishes.

show.description: Bring the Render Queue panel to the front.

name: ae_save_render_template
description: Save a queue item's render settings or output module as a named template, so later ae_add_render calls can name it instead of listing every setting.

kind.description: render saves the item's render settings; output (the default) saves its output module.

item.description: Index of the item in the render queue, 1 first, as ae_render_queue lists them.

outputModule.description: Which output module of the item, 1 first.

name: ae_watch_folder
description: Turn this After Effects into a watch folder render node, as File > Watch Folder does, or stop or pause it. While it watches, the application renders what arrives in the folder and answers little else; ae_render_queue and ae_diagnose still work.

path.description: Folder to watch for render control files.

pause.description: Pause (true) or resume (false) the watch folder.

name: ae_render_in_media_encoder
description: Send the render queue to Adobe Media Encoder, which renders in its own process and leaves After Effects free; with render_immediately it starts at once. Needs Media Encoder of the same version installed.

renderImmediately.description: Start rendering in Media Encoder at once rather than only queueing.

name: ae_farm_submit
description: Queue a render of a composition on the farm: aerender renders the saved project in its own engine, so After Effects stays free and the job runs on after this call returns. The open project is saved first unless save is false; a project path renders that file instead. Frames, templates and settings are aerender's own. The answer is the job with its id; poll it with ae_farm_jobs.

comp.description: The composition to render, by name or id.

output.description: Where to write the output: a file path, or a folder to take the composition's name; After Effects adds the extension the output module gives. Empty renders under the project folder's renders.

project.description: A saved project file to render instead of the open project.

save.description: Save the open project before rendering it, so aerender sees the latest changes; true by default.

startFrame.description: First frame to render; the composition's start when empty.

endFrame.description: Last frame to render, inclusive; the composition's end when empty.

increment.description: Render every nth frame; 1 renders all.

renderTemplate.description: Render settings template by name, as ae_render_templates lists them.

outputTemplate.description: Output module template by name, as ae_render_templates lists them.

renderSettings.description: As aerender takes them, an object of names to values; the After Effects guide to render and output settings names them.

outputSettings.description: As aerender takes them, an object of names to values; the After Effects guide to render and output settings names them.

priority.description: Higher runs first among queued jobs; 0 by default.

retries.description: How many times a failed job is tried again; 0 by default.

multiFrame.description: Multi-frame rendering on or off; aerender's default when empty.

cpuPercent.description: Most CPU percent multi-frame rendering may take, 1 to 100.

name: ae_farm_jobs
description: The farm's jobs, newest first, or one job by id: state (queued, running, done, failed, cancelled), frames rendered against the total when the span is known, the last frame and timecode, attempts and retries left, the error if any, and the tail of the log.

id.description: The job id as ae_farm_submit and ae_farm_jobs give it.

state.description: Only jobs in this state: queued, running, done, failed or cancelled.

logLines.description: Lines from the end of each job's log to include; 10 for one job, 0 for the list.

name: ae_farm_cancel
description: Stop a queued or running job; a running render is killed and its partial output stays on disk.

id.description: The job id as ae_farm_submit and ae_farm_jobs give it.

name: ae_farm_retry
description: Queue a finished, failed or cancelled job again as a new job with the same request.

id.description: The job id as ae_farm_submit and ae_farm_jobs give it.

name: ae_farm_cleanup
description: Forget finished jobs older than a number of minutes, and delete their logs; 0 forgets every finished job.

olderThanMinutes.description: Forget finished jobs older than this many minutes; 0 forgets all of them.

name: ae_template_info
description: A composition as a motion graphics template: its template name, the controllers exposed in Essential Graphics, and the instances of templates among its layers (nested compositions with essential properties) with each property's name, type and value.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_update_template
description: Name the template a composition exports as, or open it in the Essential Graphics panel.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name.description: The template name, shown in Premiere Pro and the Essential Graphics panel.

openPanel.description: Open the composition in the Essential Graphics panel.

name: ae_add_template_property
description: Expose a property of a layer as a controller of the composition's template, under a name of your choosing: a number, colour, checkbox, popup, text, 2D point or media property; others are refused with the reason.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

path.description: Path of the property, segments separated by /: match names as ae_property_tree lists them (ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position), display names in After Effects' language, the English names of the common ones (Transform/Position, Effects/<effect>/<parameter>, Masks/1/Mask Path, Text/Source Text), or 1-based indices.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name.description: Name of the controller; the property's own name when empty.

name: ae_fill_template
description: Fill an instance of a template: set the essential properties of a nested composition layer by controller name (text as a string, colours as #rrggbb or [r, g, b], numbers, points; a media controller takes a footage item by name or id, null to clear), as keyframes when time is given. The answer lists the properties afterwards.

layer.description: The nested composition layer that is the template instance, by name or index.

values.description: An object of controller names (or indices as ae_template_info numbers them) to values.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Set the values as keyframes at this time.

name: ae_substitute_template
description: Customise a template composition directly by layer name: new text for text layers, a colour for solids, text, shape fills or a Fill effect, and new footage or compositions for footage layers. Use it on compositions that are templates by convention rather than Essential Graphics.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

text.description: Layer names to the new text of each text layer.

colors.description: Layer names to the new colour of each, as #rrggbb or [r, g, b].

footage.description: Layer names to the footage item or composition (by name or id) that replaces each layer's source.

name: ae_export_template
description: Export a composition as a .mogrt motion graphics template, to a file or folder, or into the Essential Graphics library when no path is given. The composition needs at least one controller; its template name defaults to its own.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

path.description: A .mogrt file path, or a folder to take the template's name; the Essential Graphics library when empty.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that is already there.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_import_template
description: Import a .mogrt file into the project as a composition, with its controllers; into a folder when one is named. Where this After Effects refuses scripted import the answer says so.

path.description: Path of the .mogrt file.

folder.description: Project folder to put it in, by name or id; the root when empty.

open.description: Open the imported composition in the viewer.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for After Effects, 1 to 600.

name: ae_files
description: The files this server keeps, by area: files (the project folder: footage, uploads), captures, renders, jobs (farm logs with each job's state). Lists a folder with sizes; over HTTP each entry can carry a signed download link.

path.description: Path inside the area, forward slashes; empty for the area itself.

withLinks.description: Add a signed download link per entry (HTTP only).

name: ae_upload
description: Bring a file or folder from the client's machine into the files area. Over HTTP the answer is a shell command with a short-lived signed link to run on the client; over stdio both are the same machine and the answer says where the file goes.

localPath.description: File or folder on the client's machine.

remotePath.description: Where it lands in the files area; its own name when empty.

name: ae_download
description: Take a file or folder of an area to the client's machine: over HTTP a shell command with a signed link (a folder as one tar), over stdio the local path, since the file is already here.

remotePath.description: Path inside the area, forward slashes; empty for the area itself.

localPath.description: Where it lands on the client's machine; its own name when empty.

overwrite.description: Replace files already on the client's machine.

name: ae_layer_bounds
description: The pixel bounds of a layer at a time: the rectangle in the layer's own space (what sourceRectAtTime measures, text and shapes included) and, for a 2D layer, its four corners, centre and bounding box in composition pixels after transform. Use it to align and fit layers instead of guessing sizes.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

extents.description: Measure only the pixels with content rather than the layer's full extent; false by default.

name: ae_convert_point
description: Convert a point between a layer's own pixels and the composition's, at a time: where a corner of a text lands on screen, or which pixel of a footage sits under a composition point.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

to.description: comp converts from the layer's pixels into the composition (the default); source converts the other way.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_selection
description: What the user has selected in a composition: the layers, and the properties with the layer and path of each; the composition's current time comes along.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_guides
description: The guides of a composition or a footage item: index, orientation and position in its pixels.

item.description: The composition or footage item by name or id; the active composition when empty.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_set_guides
description: Change the guides of a composition or footage item in one call: add guides by orientation and position, move or remove them by index, or clear them all. The answer lists the guides afterwards.

item.description: The composition or footage item by name or id; the active composition when empty.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

add.description: Guides to add, each {orientation: horizontal or vertical, position} in the item's pixels.

remove.description: Indices of guides to remove, 0 first, as ae_guides numbers them.

name: ae_split_layer
description: Split a layer at a time into two, as Edit > Split Layer does: the part before keeps the name and goes below, the part after sits above. The answer carries both with their in and out points.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

time.description: Time in seconds within the composition; the composition's current time when empty.

name: ae_copy_layer_to_comp
description: Copy a layer with everything on it into another composition, at the top of its stack; the original stays.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

target.description: The composition the copy goes to, by name or id.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

name: ae_place_layer_corners
description: Place a 2D or 3D layer so that its top-left, top-right and bottom-left corners land on three points of the composition, as calculateTransformFromPoints solves it; the transform is applied unless apply is false, and returned either way.

layer.description: The layer by its name or its index in the composition, 1 at the top.

topLeft.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in composition pixels.

topRight.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in composition pixels.

bottomLeft.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in composition pixels.

comp.description: The composition by name or id; when empty, the active one, else the one worked on last, else the only one in the project.

apply.description: Apply the transform to the layer (true, the default) or only compute it.

time.description: Set the transform as keyframes at this time.

name: ae_find_layer
description: Find a layer anywhere in the project by its id, which ae_layer_info and ae_list_layers report, and answer with its composition and its full description; ids survive renames and reordering.

id.description: The layer's id as ae_layer_info reports it.

name: ae_project_settings
description: The project settings as Project Settings shows them, read and set in one call: time display (timecode or frames, the start frame), colour depth, linear blending, working space and gamma, colour management and OCIO config, LUT interpolation, the expression engine, GPU acceleration (with what the machine offers), transparency grid thumbnails, the active tool. With colorProfiles the answer lists the colour profiles a working space can be.

displayStartFrame.description: The frame numbers start at 0 or 1.

framesUseFeetFrames.description: Count frames in feet and frames.

feetFramesFilm.description: MM16 or MM35, for feet and frames.

footageTimecodeStart.description: FTCS_START_0 or FTCS_USE_SOURCE_MEDIA: where footage timecode starts.

bitsPerChannel.description: Colour depth: 8, 16 or 32 bits per channel.

workingSpace.description: The working colour space by profile name, as the colour profiles list spells it; empty for none.

workingGamma.description: Working gamma, 2.2 or 2.4, where the colour management system has it.

colorManagementSystem.description: Colour management system as After Effects numbers them, where the version has the setting.

ocioConfigurationFile.description: Path of an OCIO configuration file; an empty string returns to the built-in one.

lutInterpolationMethod.description: LUT interpolation method as After Effects numbers them.

gpuAccel.description: METAL, CUDA, OPENCL, DIRECTX, VULKAN or SOFTWARE; the answer lists what this machine offers.

transparencyGridThumbnails.description: Show thumbnails over a transparency grid.

tool.description: The active tool, as ToolType names it (Tool_Arrow, Tool_Pen, Tool_TextH and so on).

colorProfiles.description: List the colour profiles the working space can be set to.

defaultImportFolder.description: Folder the Import dialog opens in, on After Effects' machine.

name: ae_replace_in_expressions
description: Replace text in every expression of the project, as After Effects does when it renames something: a layer name, a property name, a comp name that expressions refer to.

find.description: Text to find in the expressions.

replace.description: Text to put in its place; empty removes the text.

name: ae_project_fonts
description: The fonts the project uses, each with the layers that use it, and the fonts that are missing or substituted on this machine.

name: ae_replace_font
description: Replace one font with another across the project, by PostScript names as ae_text_fonts gives them.

from.description: PostScript name of the font to replace.

to.description: PostScript name of the font to use instead.

reloadMissing.description: Also reload footage whose fonts were missing.

name: ae_import_placeholder
description: Add a placeholder footage item of a size, frame rate and duration, to lay out a composition before the footage exists; ae_replace_footage swaps the file in later.

folder.description: Project folder to put it in, by name or id.

name: ae_purge
description: Purge After Effects' caches: all, memory, images, snapshots or undo, as the Edit > Purge menu offers.

target.description: ALL_CACHES, ALL_MEMORY_CACHES, IMAGE_CACHES, SNAPSHOT_CACHES or UNDO_CACHES.

name: ae_performance
description: Memory and multi-frame rendering of After Effects: the image cache and total memory percentages, and multi-frame rendering on or off with a CPU ceiling; the preferences the Performance pane holds.

imageCachePercent.description: Percent of memory for the image cache; goes with maxMemoryPercent.

maxMemoryPercent.description: Percent of memory After Effects may use in all.

maxCpuPercent.description: CPU percent multi-frame rendering may take, 1 to 100.

name: ae_system_info
description: The machine After Effects runs on and the application itself: machine and user name, operating system and version, After Effects' version, build and language, memory in use, whether it is a render engine or a beta, the rendering and crash-saving flags, where its preferences live, and environment variables by name.

environment.description: Environment variables to read on After Effects' machine, by name.

name: ae_set_application
description: Application-wide switches: rendering of previews off while scripts work, an error on missing footage frames, saving the project on a crash, writing the preferences on quit.

disableRendering.description: Stop After Effects rendering previews while scripts run; speeds long batches.

reportErrorOnMissingFrame.description: Stop and report when a frame of footage is missing, rather than render on.

saveProjectOnCrash.description: Save the project when After Effects crashes.

savePreferencesOnQuit.description: Write the preferences when After Effects quits.

name: ae_read_swatches
description: Read an Adobe swatch file (.ase or .aco) through After Effects: each swatch's name, colour space and values.

path.description: Path of the .ase or .aco swatch file on After Effects' machine.

name: ae_system_call
description: Run a shell command on After Effects' machine through After Effects and return its output; it waits for the command to finish. Script-scope work: a key without that scope is refused.

name: ae_preference
description: Read one After Effects preference by section and key, as the preferences file spells them (ae_system_info says where it is), read as a string, long, float or bool.

section.description: The section in the preferences file, such as "Main Pref Section v2".

key.description: The key within the section, such as "Pref_SCRIPTING_FILE_NETWORK_SECURITY".

kind.description: How the value is read or written: string, long, float or bool.

file.description: Which preferences file: MACHINE_INDEPENDENT (the default), MACHINE_SPECIFIC, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_RENDER, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_OUTPUT, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_COMPOSITION, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_TEXT, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_PAINT, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_EFFECTS, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_EXPRESSION_SNIPPETS or MACHINE_SPECIFIC_SCRIPT_SNIPPETS.

name: ae_set_preference
description: Write, remove, reload or save to disk After Effects' preferences by section and key; a value takes effect when the preference is read next, some only after a restart. Wrong keys create new entries, so read with ae_preference first.

section.description: The section in the preferences file, such as "Main Pref Section v2".

key.description: The key within the section, such as "Pref_SCRIPTING_FILE_NETWORK_SECURITY".

value.description: The value to store, read as kind says.

kind.description: How the value is read or written: string, long, float or bool.

file.description: Which preferences file: MACHINE_INDEPENDENT (the default), MACHINE_SPECIFIC, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_RENDER, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_OUTPUT, MACHINE_INDEPENDENT_COMPOSITION, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_TEXT, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_PAINT, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_EFFECTS, MACHINE_SPECIFIC_EXPRESSION_SNIPPETS or MACHINE_SPECIFIC_SCRIPT_SNIPPETS.

remove.description: Remove the preference instead of setting it.

saveToDisk.description: Write the preferences file to disk afterwards.

reload.description: Re-read the preferences file first, dropping unsaved changes.

name: ae_script_setting
description: Read a setting scripts keep between sessions in After Effects, by section and key: the key-value store of app.settings.

section.description: The section, usually the script's or tool's name.

name: ae_save_script_setting
description: Keep a text under a section and key in After Effects' script settings, where it survives restarts.

section.description: The section, usually the script's or tool's name.

name: ae_quit
description: Quit After Effects: with unsaved changes it saves first or drops them as save says, and refuses when save is not given. The bridge returns once it is running again.

save.description: With unsaved changes: true saves the project first, false drops the changes; empty refuses to quit.

name: ae_viewer
description: The active viewer: composition, layer or footage viewer, whether it is maximized, its views with the active one, and each view's channels, checkerboards, exposure, fast preview mode, rulers, guides and zoom.

name: ae_set_viewer
description: Change a view of the active viewer: the channel shown, transparency checkerboards, exposure in stops, fast preview mode, rulers, guides visibility, snapping and locking, zoom; maximize the viewer or make the view active.

view.description: Which view of the viewer, 1 first; the active view when empty.

channels.description: CHANNEL_RGB, CHANNEL_RGB_STRAIGHT, CHANNEL_RED, CHANNEL_GREEN, CHANNEL_BLUE, CHANNEL_ALPHA, CHANNEL_ALPHA_BOUNDARY, CHANNEL_ALPHA_OVERLAY, CHANNEL_RED_COLORIZE, CHANNEL_GREEN_COLORIZE or CHANNEL_BLUE_COLORIZE.

fastPreview.description: FP_OFF, FP_ADAPTIVE_RESOLUTION, FP_DRAFT, FP_FAST_DRAFT or FP_WIREFRAME.

maximized.description: Maximize the viewer panel, or restore it.

activate.description: Make this view and its viewer active.

name: ae_workers
description: The pool of After Effects workers: each one's name, state (starting, ready, leased, stopping, gone), origin (launched by this server, or adopted when a named instance somebody else started connected), pid, uptime, who holds it and how long it sat idle; with the pool's limits and which worker this client is bound to. The desk is not a worker.

name: ae_lease
description: Take an After Effects of your own: binds this client to a free worker, to the one named, or to a fresh one the server launches when the pool has room, waiting for it to come up; from then on every command of this client goes there. With project, a copy of that file is opened in it. release gives the worker back and commands return to the desk.

worker.description: The worker by name, such as w1, as ae_workers lists them.

launch.description: Launch a new After Effects when no worker is free; true by default.

project.description: A project file on the server's machine to copy into the worker's folder and open there.

release.description: Give the worker back instead of taking one.

name: ae_stop_worker
description: Quit a worker, dropping its project unsaved, and free whoever held it; the pool launches another when it is below its minimum.

worker.description: The worker by name, such as w1, as ae_workers lists them.
